description: What the owner can open and try after every build section. tools/showcase.py turns this file, the visuals index, the catalog and tools/blueprint_numbers.py into one offline page (web/showcase/dist/lynkomni-showcase.html). Emulator links point at the private pages Claude publishes after each section; update the link when a page is republished under a new address.

sections.title: Business app and the whole of LynkPOS
LynkAcc, LynkInv, LynkCRM, LynkStat and LynkOps
Customer app, shop pages and pay pages

emulators.title: LynkOmni Account site
emulators.what: Sign-up in four steps, sign-in with a passkey, the three recovery paths, Security Center and every account page, your orders with live trackers, and Run your affairs: a workspace for yourself, a company or an organisation. Computer, tablet and phone. Also My Storefront (your public page, Storefront plan and the partner's identity check before a first paid offer), support split between your workspace and seller support, and the age step at sign-up. It picks the right view for your device by itself.
emulators.try: Open Orders and bookings to see two trackers; open Businesses and start a personal or organisation workspace; then Create account and go through the four steps. Then open the account menu, choose My Storefront and start the identity check; in Support cases, open a seller support case.

emulators.title: Shared shell (browser frame)
emulators.what: The frame every LynkOmni screen sits in: header with the side you are in (your workspace or Storefront), navigation, launcher, search, help, notifications, connection and sync states, overlays, dark, lite and sunlight modes. It picks the right view for your device by itself (phone, tablet, computer, touch or mouse) and fits every screen from a 240 px watch to a 4K television.
emulators.try: Open the account menu: switch to Storefront, then Change view and Why this view?. Use the testing controls to try other views and widths; swipe from the edge on a phone to open the launcher.

emulators.title: Business app on a phone, tablet or computer
emulators.what: Every Business app screen of blueprint 41 E: getting in, Sell with every payment way, today's sales, shifts, practice mode, Stock, Chats, every Business section and setting, and the four business types (shop, without a till, agent point, restaurant), on a phone, a tablet side rail or a computer web view, in every language and offline. Setup now starts with who it is for (yourself, a company or an organisation), which changes the words, tabs and categories; Deliveries shows every delivery with its tracker.
emulators.try: Sign in, choose Myself or An organisation in setup and see the Books tab; or make a sale, press Deliver this order and watch the delivery move on the Deliveries screen.

emulators.title: LynkPOS handheld terminal
emulators.what: A physical handheld terminal: 12-tile home, selling, agent services, vouchers and pickup codes, the credit book, shifts and cash counts, receipt printer that prints, scanner and cash drawer, a low-literacy setting, on sandbox adapters.
emulators.try: Open Agent from the home tiles, send a cash-out and see why cash waits for the partner; then sell and print a receipt.

emulators.title: LynkPOS counter tablet
emulators.what: A counter till: tablet on a stand with a customer-facing screen, scanner, cash drawer and printer; tables, kitchen, shifts, day close, staff, deliveries, buy together, setup, credit and sell by voice.
emulators.try: Unlock with PIN 1234, sell two items, take cash and close the shift.

emulators.title: LynkPOS kitchen screen
emulators.what: The kitchen display: tickets in order, lines marked ready, late tickets highlighted, and printed slips on the Free plan.
emulators.try: Send a test order from the panel and mark its lines ready.

emulators.title: LynkPOS customer display
emulators.what: The screen the customer sees at the till: welcome, the basket line by line, pay by QR with an honest state, thank you.
emulators.try: Add items and pay; watch the state go from sent to confirmed.

emulators.title: Rider phone
emulators.what: The shop's own rider: jobs, pickup, delivery with the customer's code or a parcel photo (never a person), each job's tracker, and Share trip progress (the rider's choice, this trip only; never a position).
emulators.try: Open a job, turn on Share trip progress, pick it up and deliver with the code.

emulators.title: LynkStock handheld scanner
emulators.what: A rugged scanner: count, receive and adjust stock by barcode, with below-zero items flagged for a recount.
emulators.try: Press the trigger to scan, then count and save.

emulators.title: LynkPOS on a button phone
emulators.what: Selling and checking stock from a basic phone through a short-code menu, for places without smartphones.
emulators.try: Use the arrow keys to make a sale and read today's total.

emulators.title: LynkVCard as a real card
emulators.what: The four card faces (Free, Plus, Pro, Max), flip, freeze that shows only after the issuer confirms, and card details only after step-up inside the issuer's display.
emulators.try: Flip the card, then freeze it and watch it wait for the issuer.

emulators.title: LynkMesh relay between devices
emulators.what: Two devices, one offline: a sale travels sealed through the nearby device and shows sent, awaiting cloud until the cloud accepts it; a tampered packet is refused.
emulators.try: Sell on device A, relay, and try the tamper test.

emulators.title: Owner's web view on a laptop
emulators.what: The owner's browser view: today, sales, devices, staff, agent commissions, every automation with why and an off switch, and data sharing. Selling stays on registered devices.
emulators.try: Open Automations and press Why did this happen?

emulators.title: Customer's tracking page
emulators.what: What a customer sees from the shop's tracking link, with no account: each step of the order and its delivery, the promised time, a late notice, the share of the trip done (never a position), Tell me each step by text or chat, and the last known step when offline.
emulators.try: Pick a stage in the panel (placed to delivered, late or failed), then press By text message; switch the connection off to see the last known step.
